run-boundary.ownership: README sections 2 and 6: each C owner retains its own state; broker owns world; evaluator owns post-run analysis.
run-boundary.authority: README sections 2 and 4: exact public mission grants only; model has no tool/operator authority; evaluator receives artifacts only after closure.
run-boundary.shape_versions: SOURCE_PINS and RUN_CONFIG: native source/public schemas retained; new intent/image/clock schemas proposed and block contract acceptance; exact processor/model versions required.
run-boundary.identity_scope: Run/session/workspace plus issuer/source/epoch/document/occurrence, exact selectors and hashes; duplicate payload is not duplicate occurrence.
run-boundary.time_order: README clock contract: simulation year, source time, receipt, commit and knowledge cut distinct; inference takes a pinned cut; offline transfer after closure.
run-boundary.delivery_idempotency: README restart contract: original stable request/body and operation replay; changed reuse conflicts; no assumed inference HTTP deduplication.
run-boundary.commit_recovery: README section 2: no distributed transaction; write-ahead intent, broker replay, C1 occurrence commit then C0 ack; unresolved workers require trusted reconciliation.
run-boundary.retention: Private durable run volumes and acquired bytes through analysis; no runtime garbage collection of supporting evidence; capacity yields. Secrets/databases excluded from Git.
run-boundary.resource_limits: RUN_CONFIG proposed root budgets and stricter owner/public page/chunk/job caps; all prompt/image/helper/failed work charged or unknown.
run-boundary.errors: Explicit denied/unsupported/unavailable/conflict/partial/capacity/timeout/uncertain completion; no semantic answer fabrication or silent fallback.
run-boundary.feedback_grounding: Public acquired records remain reports/simulation observations; model/teacher/derived/simulated output is not independent external evidence; no evaluator-to-runtime feedback.

component-connection-v1.ownership: Existing C0-C7 native stores remain authoritative. C0 coordinates and retains selected results; C1 owns bytes, C3 admits world changes, C4 owns model jobs/rejections, C6 owns assessments and C7 adopts authority. See COMPONENT_CONNECTIONS.md Connections and Failure contract.
component-connection-v1.authority: Finite component-call catalogue uses existing ports through C0. No raw model intake, recursive job control, direct cross-owner SQL, C3 admission or C7 operator adoption/reconciliation is model-accessible. Trusted-local Workflow operator APIs remain separate.
component-connection-v1.shape_versions: Source 0.10.0.dev0, C4 edi-c4/0.6.0, operations edi-native-operations/1.2. Existing native request schemas are reused and namespaced for serving. Fresh workspaces; no migration of historical episodes. See generated-contracts.json.
component-connection-v1.identity_scope: ApplicationProfile and Runtime check one workspace and eight separate database paths. C0 supplies command identities. C1 source/occurrence identity, C3 revisions and exact model job/context hashes remain native; labels do not authenticate physical identity.
component-connection-v1.time_order: Original C4 cut and prospective C6 rules remain immutable. C0 persists one deadline across restarts and checks before jobs/dispatch. Teacher feedback is later generated assistance against the original exported cut; operator compliance is declared, not independently observed.
component-connection-v1.delivery_idempotency: C0 phases reuse native request IDs and owner receipts. C4 provider journal claims once; unknown completion never authorizes correction/resend. File teacher exchange waits explicitly and retains one immutable imported result per job. Broker deduplicates original requests under its existing contract.
component-connection-v1.commit_recovery: C0 phase results and C4 job/rejection state are separate owner commits. C1 retains raw outputs before native admission. Native staged C3 submissions retain their own receipt recovery. Runtime crash/fault cases remain unrun; a local lock is not multi-process isolation.
component-connection-v1.retention: Original C1 payloads, C4 episodes/rejections and component artifacts remain in their native finite stores. Bounded contexts may omit/truncate them with selectors. No new retention eviction, backup/restore, migration or unlimited replay guarantee is introduced.
component-connection-v1.resource_limits: Native profiles retain finite bytes/items/work. C0 defaults 32 turns, 262144 conservatively charged tokens, 3600 seconds, maximum one correction per rejected attempt; an inquiry reserves at most six 16K jobs and four student rounds. Per-journal byte quotas are independent, not a hard aggregate memory/disk/energy bound.
component-connection-v1.errors: Known bad returned content becomes a C4 rejection and bounded correction/yield. No-dispatch dependency failures wait for the original model job. Teacher export awaits input. Unknown provider/storage completion remains unresolved; native tool errors return as attributed context. No silent scientific content repair.
component-connection-v1.feedback_grounding: Component artifacts, teacher critique and reasoning memory are generated lineage, not independent world evidence. C3 candidates and C6 advice do not become accepted truth. File teacher identity, usage and adherence to the exported cut remain operator-declared; fixed weights and original authority are retained.

feedback_reviews.analysis: EDI's selected exposure, optional correlated teacher critique and world interventions form a delayed learning loop. Teacher has the same cut and cannot act or corroborate itself. C1 originals, C3 candidates, generated outputs and actual constructed observations remain distinct. Broker replay and atomic first-dispatch claims prevent repeated admitted work; missing provider completion retains unknown cost. No evaluator return path. Full host/egress/isolation bounds remain unqualified. The new count/generation feedback compares exact admitted prompt count with actual usage, rejecting disagreement. Correlated source features/model output do not become independent evidence. Shared-uid Kaggle diagnostics are not a hard security boundary. Current source adds C0-mediated component-result feedback, candidate continuity, same-cut file teacher critique/student revision and bounded rejection correction. Generated echoes stay generated; no runtime feedback effectiveness or hard isolation is claimed.

outside_dependencies.name: Trusted operator control
outside_dependencies.contract: One explicit initial grant; separate C3/operator changes/recovery and human objective decision; not model-callable.

outside_dependencies.name: Host/GPU/container runtime
outside_dependencies.contract: Trusted-host threat model, no host mounts/PID/IPC; prestaged artifacts and measured resource profile before launch.

internal_owner_inventory.proposed_changes: Extend only existing C0/C1/C4/C7 duties and version external dependency contracts; no direct C4-C7 or C4-C5 bypass. Re-run full owner/interface review when implementing.

findings.description: Existing native owner operations and their return results are wired in source; source checks recorded separately from execution.
New-version runtime, crash, authority, teacher/student and end-to-end investigation cases are intentionally unrun.
Wider original conceptual/component obligations, automatic hosted teacher, hard isolation, training and unsupported numerical/perception functions are outside existing-port wiring.

review.scope_limit: Source wiring is implemented and build-checked. Original wider contracts remain proposed; runtime and product cases were not run at owner direction. Historical 0.9.4 evidence is not promoted.
